# Command reference

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-command-docs.py — do not edit -->

Installed as a plugin, every command is also available namespaced: `/feature-flow:<command>`.

## Foundations

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`/constitution`](constitution.md) | Derives the non-negotiable project principles from the PRD, and offers a portable `AGENTS.md`. |
| [`/design`](design.md) | Creates or updates `DESIGN.md`: tokens, component inventory, surfaces, states and accessibility baseline. Reconciles mockups from `design/mockups/`. |
| [`/prd`](prd.md) | Guided discovery interview that produces the Product Requirements Document. |
| [`/roadmap`](roadmap.md) | Breaks the PRD into ordered features `F-001…` with dependencies, sizes and milestones. |

## Feature

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`/analyze`](analyze.md) | Read-only consistency check across PRD, constitution, spec, plan, tasks and `DESIGN.md` using parallel analysts. |
| [`/clarify`](clarify.md) | Resolves ambiguities in a spec, one question at a time, and edits the spec in place. |
| [`/implement`](implement.md) | Implements the next pending task in your own context (manual mode). |
| [`/plan`](plan.md) | Writes the technical plan: architecture decisions, affected files, phases, parallelism notes, test strategy. |
| [`/qa`](qa.md) | Project-wide quality audit delegated to the isolated `qa-verifier` agent. |
| [`/review`](review.md) | Independent review by `spec-reviewer` and `quality-reviewer` in parallel, merged into `review.md` with a mechanical verdict. |
| [`/specify`](specify.md) | Creates the feature's git worktree and branch, then writes its spec with testable acceptance criteria. |
| [`/tasks`](tasks.md) | Breaks the plan into atomic tasks with dependencies, write scopes and AC coverage, and computes parallel execution waves. |

## Automation

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`/build`](build.md) | The orchestrator: implements tasks in parallel waves with isolated workers, reviews with independent agents, converges on gaps, runs QA, and hands over to `/ship`. |

## Delivery

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`/merge`](merge.md) | Answers PR review comments, squash merges, updates `main` and removes the feature worktree and branches. |
| [`/review-pr`](review-pr.md) | Fetches PR review comments, fixes the issues and replies to each comment. |
| [`/ship`](ship.md) | Runs quality gates, commits, pushes and opens the pull request from the feature branch. |

## Navigation

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`/status`](status.md) | Shows roadmap progress (derived from tracks), active worktrees and the single next action to take. |
